# Whinbrae Farm - clamp and stock

Shared folder for the farm team.

- clamp/  cards for each silage clamp
- stock/  ration notes from the yard

turns.prompt: A stockman at Whinbrae Farm asked what the dry matter figure on a silage card means for the clamp; it is the share of the weighed grass that is left once the water is taken out. Clamp CL-71 weighed 28.4 tonnes at 32 percent dry matter. Give the dry matter in that clamp, in tonnes.
